# id: # Runecraft methods from the OSRS Wiki training pages and the Ironman / Ultimate Ironman guides (see source). "?" = rate not on the wiki; "our estimate" = xp per hour divided by xp each.

name: Crafting air runes (F2P)
where: Air Altar, just south of Falador
note: 5 xp per essence (140 per 28-slot inventory); no xp/h given. Pure essence (2 gp each) is cheaper than rune essence (12 gp each) per the F2P page.

name: Crafting earth tiaras (F2P)
where: Earth Altar via Varrock Teleport, then bank
note: Up to 27,000 xp/h per the wiki; 32.5 xp per earth tiara (wiki table) makes 831 per hour our estimate (27,000 / 32.5).

name: Enter the Abyss quest
note: One-time 1,000 Runecraft xp, enough for level 9 per the Ironman guide; needed to repair essence pouches. Hardcore ironmen should note the Wilderness trip.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Runecraft training; Ironman Guide/Runecraft 2026-11-11

name: Temple of the Eye quest
where: Quest; unlocks Guardians of the Rift
note: One-time 9,210 Runecraft xp in total (4,210 during, 5,000 after); requires Runecraft 10 and unlocks the Guardians of the Rift minigame (Runecraft 27).
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Runecraft training; Ironman Guide/Runecraft 2026-11-11

name: The Eyes of Glouphrie quest
note: One-time 6,000 Runecraft xp. The Ironman guide lists only Construction 5 and Magic 46, while the UIM guide also lists Woodcutting 45; verify.
source: OSRS Wiki Ironman Guide/Runecraft; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Runecraft; Pay-to-play Runecraft training 2026-11-11

name: What Lies Below quest
note: One-time 8,000 Runecraft xp; the P2P guide advises training to 35 before doing it. Its prerequisites were not listed on the pages read.

name: Crafting talisman tiaras
where: Elemental altars (talisman used on altar with a tiara)
note: Fastest method up to level 50 per the P2P guide, with no quest or skill requirement. Model-extracted summary gives about 36,300 (air) to 58,000 (elemental) xp/h at about 1,450 tiaras/h, but the page does not tie tiers to levels.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Runecraft training 2026-11-11 ; xp OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Runecraft training 2026-11-11

name: Ourania Altar (pure essence)
note: Pure essence rates from the P2P summary (about 20,400 xp/h at levels 1-9, 77,100 at 99). Ourania Teleport needs Lunar Diplomacy and 71 Magic (recommended, not listed as required); the Ironman guide lists this method from level 23.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Runecraft training; Ironman Guide/Runecraft 2026-11-11

name: Crafting lava runes (solo)
note: Rates are from the P2P summary for the full solo setup (Raiments of the Eye, colossal pouch). Magic 82 and Lunar Diplomacy are for the fastest version only. The Ironman guide says elemental talismans are hard to get in bulk for ironmen.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Runecraft training; Ironman Guide/Runecraft 2026-11-11

name: Guardians of the Rift minigame
note: Wiki table (Ironman guide; UIM guide matches) gives Runecraft xp/h from 40 (25,000) to 99 (70,000), plus passive Mining and Crafting. Full Raiments of the Eye give 60% more runes; no rate is given below 40.
source: OSRS Wiki Ironman Guide/Runecraft; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Runecraft; Pay-to-play Runecraft training 2026-11-11

name: Arceuus Library book turn-ins
note: Each book gives 5 x current Runecraft level in xp. The Ironman guide says about 160 books/h with stamina potions gives 44,800 xp/h at 70, which does not match 160 x 350; the UIM summary implies about 52,500 at 70 (150 books/h). Viable up to 99 per the UIM guide.
source: OSRS Wiki Ironman Guide/Runecraft; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Runecraft 2026-11-11

name: Crafting blood runes in Arceuus
where: Arceuus (Kourend) altar, using mined dense essence blocks
note: Rate from a model-extracted summary of the Ironman guide table (about 37,000 xp/h without the diary). The UIM guide calls it safe and advises keeping blood runes for barrage rather than selling.
source: OSRS Wiki Ironman Guide/Runecraft; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Runecraft 2026-11-11

name: Crafting soul runes in Arceuus
where: Arceuus (Kourend) altar, using mined dense essence blocks
note: About 45,000 xp/h at 90 per a model-extracted summary of the Ironman guide table. Soul runes are much less profitable than blood runes, and the UIM guide says they have few uses beyond Blood Barrage, so selling is advised.
source: OSRS Wiki Ironman Guide/Runecraft; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Runecraft 2026-11-11

name: Crafting wrath runes
note: Up to about 39,000 xp/h with the Runecraft and Crafting capes per the UIM summary (level not stated; listed at 95). The Ironman guide allows a wrath or catalytic talisman. The UIM guide calls the dragon run potentially dangerous and advises against Item Retrieval Service storage.
source: OSRS Wiki Ironman Guide/Runecraft; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Runecraft 2026-11-11
